conventions.name: domain-does-not-import-adapters-or-infrastructure
conventions.description: Domain modules must stay framework-free: they must not import adapters or infrastructure code.
conventions.hint: Move the framework-specific logic behind a port and inject it into the domain, instead of importing adapters/infrastructure directly.

conventions.name: ports-are-protocols-or-abcs
conventions.description: Port modules define the boundary between domain and adapters as a Protocol or ABC.
conventions.hint: Define this port as a typing.Protocol or abc.ABC subclass so adapters can be swapped without changing the domain.

conventions.name: adapters-export-adapter-suffix
conventions.description: Adapter modules implement a port and export a class whose name ends in Adapter.
conventions.hint: Name the implementing class with an Adapter suffix (e.g. PostgresOrderRepositoryAdapter) so it's identifiable as a port implementation.

conventions.name: use-cases-paired-with-tests
conventions.description: Each use-case module has a matching test module.
conventions.hint: Add a tests/use_cases/test_<name>.py covering this use case's application logic.
